fc149bdda052a23ffe9a6a7bae0d8f71d08a8a5f.summary: This is a project README for godoh, a proof-of-concept command-and-control framework written in Go that uses DNS-over-HTTPS as its transport. It describes installation, build steps, command-line usage and a GPL v3 license. It is a software project page rather than a threat report, so it records no actors, incidents, CVEs or other threat facts.

fcdc48050d4a7d14d7fb3a7d181e8691472925e4.summary: CrowdStrike Intelligence overview of threats to VMware ESXi hypervisors and vCenter. It covers the lack of antivirus support in ESXi, OpenSLP flaws exploited in the ESXiArgs ransomware campaign reported by CERT-FR, ransomware-as-a-service platforms and named adversaries, common attack vectors such as credential theft and VM escape, and protective recommendations.

fc16fa5d5bbca92275d1e8e490574ba7cfd5f807.summary: Google Security Operations blog post by Mandiant on the NUMOZYLOD PowerShell malware family. It is delivered in trojanized MSIX installers through malvertising, with activity seen since mid-2023. Mandiant attributes its distribution to UNC4536, a malware-as-a-service operator. The post describes two variants that delivered CARBANAK and LUMMASTEALER, the execution path, host reconnaissance and persistence. It also gives hunting queries and detection rules for the platform.
